display.purpose: Landing page hero headline only. Never in the authenticated app shell.

headline.purpose: Brand surface section headings. Instrument Sans equivalent (text-xl font-semibold) used in product shell.

title.purpose: Card headings, page titles, modal headers in the product register.

body.purpose: All body copy, form labels, descriptions. Max 65-75ch for sustained reading.

label.purpose: Badge text, table column headers, helper text, microcopy.

shadows.name: ambient-low
shadows.purpose: Cards and containers at rest (shadow-sm). Present to clarify surface separation.

shadows.name: ambient-xs
shadows.purpose: Buttons at rest (shadow-xs). Slight lift for interactive elements.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for state transitions (ease-out-expo). Feels responsive without being aggressive.

motion.name: duration-fast
motion.purpose: Button hover, input focus ring. Instantaneous-feeling feedback.

motion.name: duration-standard
motion.purpose: Modal open/close, panel transitions, skeleton fade.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main call to action. Terracota background, used for submit, confirm, and primary navigation actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: oklch(0.556 0.162 41.0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; border: none; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px oklch(0.145 0 0 / 0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 150ms; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.500 0.162 41.0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.556 0.162 41.0 / 0.50); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Tertiary action or icon-only button. No visual weight at rest; reveals background on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.950 0.010 68.0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.556 0.162 41.0 / 0.50); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Irreversible actions only: delete, reject, remove. Must appear inside a confirmation dialog, never as the default CTA on a page.

narrative.overview:
Impacta is a gathering place — warm and welcoming enough that a first-time donor feels at home, structured and reliable enough that an institution trusts it with their daily operations. The visual system reflects this duality: a terracota-and-areia palette that feels handmade and human, paired with a product shell that is unambiguously clear and efficient.

The system does not decorate. Every color, weight, and radius earns its place by serving a functional or emotional purpose. The terracota is used because it makes every primary action feel warm and intentional instead of corporate and cold. The sage green marks verified trust. The areia canvas is the color of paper — something made by human hands.

A screen in this system should be calm on first glance and obvious on second.
keyCharacteristics: Terracota primary on a warm areia canvas
Playfair Display for brand surfaces, Instrument Sans for the product shell
Restrained decoration — tonal contrast creates depth, not shadows
Status colors are functional, never ambient
PT-BR throughout — labels, errors, empty states

rules.name: The Restraint Rule
rules.body: Terracota is reserved for primary actions and the brand panel. It must not appear on informational elements, backgrounds, borders, or decorative shapes in the product app. Its presence should feel deliberate every time.

rules.name: The No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: Never use #ffffff or oklch(1 0 0). Every neutral must carry the warm 68–70° tint (chroma ≥ 0.005).

rules.name: The Playfair Boundary Rule
rules.body: Playfair Display lives in the brand register. It must not appear inside the authenticated app shell — sidebar, dashboard, tables, settings. The boundary is the login event.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface is flat at rest. Shadows appear only to disambiguate layers. If adding a shadow is purely decorative, remove it.

dos: Keep terracota to primary actions and the brand panel
Use tonal surface contrast as the primary depth signal
Use Playfair Display only on brand/landing surfaces
Write all UI copy in PT-BR
Include explicit empty states and loading skeletons for every data-driven list
Give every interactive element a visible focus ring (3px terracota ring)
donts: Don't use blue-and-white as a color scheme — the generic NGO look is explicitly forbidden
Don't use app-corporate-cold aesthetic: heavy enterprise shadows, gray-heavy palettes, clinical whites
Don't use marketplace density: never compete multiple CTAs, never reduce card padding for more items
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe accent
Don't use #ffffff or #000000 — every neutral carries the warm tint
Don't place Playfair Display in dashboards, tables, sidebars, or settings pages
Don't use pending-amber or sage-green outside their functional roles
